title: answer-synthesis-v2
description: The only reply the answer-synthesis-v2 prompt accepts from a model. Every key is required, no other key is allowed (there is no field for reasoning), and the reply is refused when any bound fails. Every number of a claim is a figure: an explicit (researcherId, metric, value, evidenceIds) tuple whose placeholder {figure-N} (N counts the claim's figures from 1) appears exactly once in the claim text; each figure's evidenceIds are among the claim's evidenceIds, and every {figure-N} in the text names an existing figure. The claim verifier checks each tuple against the cited item that holds that metric for that researcher (a publication year: for that work ID) and renders the number from the evidence. A ranking position is the figure (researcherId, rank, position, the ranking's evidence ID). Under claim-verifier-v3 only figures are verified, each as its own structured claim written from the evidence; all free text (claim text, summary, uncertainty) is labeled UNVERIFIED interpretation and is never verified. Evidence IDs are checked for existence by the claim verifier, not here.
